ja: • 次元断層に登場した艦艇を立体化。
• 全長約283ミリのメルトリア級航宙巡洋戦艦と全長約144ミリの次元潜航艦UX-01のセット。
• 空間格闘戦闘機DWG262「ツヴァルケ」のメルダ機と一般機各１機ずつがボーナスメカコレとして付属。成形品×11、ホイルシール×1、スライドマーク×1、組立説明書
en: • Three-dimensional version of the ships that appeared in Dimensional Fault.
• A set of the Meltria-class space cruiser with a total length of approximately 283 mm and the dimensional submarine UX-01 with a total length of approximately 144 mm.
• One Melda machine and one general machine of space combat fighter DWG262 "Zwarke" are included as bonus mechanical collection. Molded product x 11, foil seal x 1, slide mark x 1, assembly manual
